name: Output per tech worker
question: Are fewer people producing more?
metric: US information sector real output per worker, Q4 2022 = 100
solvedIf: Output keeps rising while fewer people produce it
trendLabel: US information sector real output and employment, both set to 100 in Q4 2022.
caution: The information sector is not just software. It also includes telecoms, publishing, film and broadcasting.

The cause is open. Output per worker was already growing about 7% a year before the pandemic, and layoffs, interest rates or pricing can raise it too, so only the gain above that earlier trend counts toward the score. These figures are US only.
rule: More per worker when output per worker is higher than a year before.

analysis.title: What the numbers show
analysis.intro: Output is +35% and employment is -10% since Q4 2022, but most of the gain follows an older trend.
points: Output per worker already grew about 7% a year from 2015 to 2019.
The latest figure is +16% against that trend, and that gap is what counts toward the score.

scoreReason: Output per worker is +16% against its 2015 to 2019 trend. Doubling that trend scores 100%.
